objective: V4.0 Cognitive Memory — spark-based cognitive system with structured memory, graph intelligence, automated context orchestration, stability safeguards, and security by design.
context: Crowley 3.9.19 shipped. V3.9.12 portable writeback foreshadows lanes. V4 adds separate sparks/spark_links/patterns tables layered on memory_items. New /api/cognitive/* namespace. 24 focused tickets. Plan: tickets/v4.0_cognitive_memory.json supersedes v4.0_spark_lanes.json.
decisions: Separate tables: memory_items (raw) → sparks → patterns; do not remove memory_items
New API namespace: POST /api/cognitive/ingest, GET /api/cognitive/context; existing endpoints untouched
Reuse embed_text() and EMBED_DIM; add spark_vec parallel to memory_vec
OpenAI LLM only for spark extraction; all retrieval/ranking/lane selection is deterministic code
trust_state on sparks coexists with memory_tiers on memory_items
No hard delete — archive to rejected only
Canonical score: 0.40 semantic + 0.25 confidence + 0.15 recency + 0.20 graph_reinforcement
Spark content max 300 chars; LLM returns JSON array only; 1 retry then discard batch
Field encryption deferred V4.1; content_encrypted schema hook only
non_goals: Remove or replace memory_items, memory_vec, or retrieve_memories()
Use OpenAI for retrieval, ranking, or lane selection
Auto-promote patterns or sparks to canon
Pattern data feeding back into LLM extraction
Cloud sync, external collectors, multi-user isolation
risks: Triple spark concept (legacy memories, staged memory_items, new sparks table)
Breaking embedding pipeline if not reusing embed_text pattern
qa_expectations: CROWLEY_TEST_MODE=1 CROWLEY_EMBED_PROVIDER=off python -m unittest discover -s tests -v; each ticket adds focused tests; full suite green before T24.
next_action: T1–T13 shipped (#203–#215). Part 1 ASE/GitHub + bridge E2E locked 2026-07-07. Cursor claims #216 (T14) — context depth modes, cold start, extended trace. Version bump only at T24 (#226).

approval.note: V4 Cognitive Memory plan approved for mint. Supersedes v4.0_spark_lanes.json.

tickets.title: V4 T1: sparks table schema
tickets.description: Create sparks.py with setup_spark_tables() wired into crowley.py setup_db(). sparks table: content (max 300), lane, sensitivity (normal/sensitive/high), tags_json, why_keep, worth_reason, confidence, base_confidence, trust_state (candidate/active/stale/pinned/rejected), access_count, last_accessed_at, source_refs_json, owner_id, content_encrypted hook, lineage_json, source_memory_item_id, project_id, embedding_blob, embed_model, embed_dim, created_at, updated_at. Export SPARK_LANES and SPARK_TRUST_STATES enums. Sensitive lanes default trust_state=candidate. No scope beyond schema.
acceptance: All planned columns present including sensitivity, owner_id, lineage_json, content_encrypted

tickets.title: V4 T2: spark_links and patterns tables
tickets.description: Add spark_links (from_spark_id, to_spark_id, link_type, confidence, created_at) and patterns (content, lane, source_spark_ids_json, reasoning, confidence, trust_state, created_at, updated_at) in sparks.py setup. FK integrity to sparks. Depends on T1.
acceptance: FK constraints enforce valid spark references
tests/test_spark_schema.py covers links and patterns tables

tickets.title: V4 T3: spark validation module
tickets.description: Implement validate_spark() in sparks.py: required fields (content ≤300 chars, lane, why_keep, worth_reason, confidence 0-1), lane enum strict (no auto-correct), sensitivity enum. Hard reject: instruction phrasing, vague filler, whole-input summary, over-length, invalid lane. Depends on T1.
acceptance: Each rejection case has dedicated test (instructions, vague, over-length, invalid lane)

tickets.title: V4 T4: LLM spark extraction
tickets.description: Create spark_extraction.py: OpenAI prompt enforcing JSON array ONLY (no prose). Required per item: content, lane, why_keep, worth_reason, confidence. 1 retry with stricter prompt; second failure discards entire batch (no partial acceptance). CROWLEY_TEST_MODE returns fixture. Patterns table NOT read. Depends on T3.
acceptance: Valid JSON array parsed into candidate sparks
Test mode uses fixture without API call

tickets.title: V4 T5: cognitive ingest endpoint and async queue
tickets.description: POST /api/cognitive/ingest in app.py: sync save_memory_item() receipt then async worker for extraction. ?sync=1 for tests/debug only. enforce_dispatch_invariants('cognitive.ingest'). Code assigns trust_state/confidence defaults — LLM never writes memory state. Depends on T4.
acceptance: Async worker completes spark pipeline by default

tickets.title: V4 T6: spark dedup and merge at creation
tickets.description: Dedup before INSERT in sparks.py: embedding similarity > 0.85 → merge (append source_refs_json) or reinforces link. Never create redundant spark. Depends on T3, T5.

tickets.title: V4 T7: spark embeddings and spark_vec
tickets.description: index_spark_embedding() reusing crowley.py embed_text() and pack/unpack helpers. spark_vec virtual table parallel to memory_vec. Depends on T1.
acceptance: Spark embed on save writes embedding_blob and spark_vec row
Reuses existing EMBED_DIM and provider gate

tickets.title: V4 T8: spark retrieval and canonical scoring
tickets.description: spark_retrieval.py: hybrid candidate pool, score = 0.40*semantic + 0.25*confidence + 0.15*recency + 0.20*graph_reinforcement. No AI in selection. Deterministic tie-break id ASC. Bump access_count and last_accessed_at on retrieval. Depends on T7.
acceptance: Same inputs produce identical output (determinism test)

tickets.title: V4 T9: graph links CRUD limits and confidence
tickets.description: spark_graph.py: create link only if semantic sim ≥ 0.75 (SPARK_LINK_MIN_SIM) OR explicit reinforcement. SPARK_MAX_LINKS=15. Rate limit 10 new links/spark/day. Depends on T2, T7.

tickets.title: V4 T10: graph expansion and pruning
tickets.description: Bounded graph traversal: max 50 nodes/query, hops per depth mode. Graph reinforcement in ranking. No orphan expansion — only from scored hits. Prune links confidence < 0.3 and age > 30d. Depends on T9, T8.

tickets.title: V4 T11: pattern detection and creation
tickets.description: patterns.py: cluster detection ≥3 sparks, avg confidence ≥ 0.6, same lane, semantic sim ≥ 0.85. Store source_spark_ids_json and reasoning. Depends on T2, T8.

tickets.title: V4 T12: pattern safety gates
tickets.description: Auto-promote pattern to active only; never auto-canon. Patterns must NOT influence spark creation, override spark confidence, or feed LLM extraction. Pattern boost +0.05 lifecycle-only. Rate limit 5 patterns/hour. Depends on T11.
acceptance: Extraction does not read patterns table (test enforced)

tickets.title: V4 T13: context orchestration pipeline
tickets.description: context_orchestration.py + GET /api/cognitive/context: lane parse → retrieve → rank → expand → patterns → split core/supporting. Register cognitive.context Actions tool with bearer auth. Depends on T8, T10, T12.
acceptance: GET /api/cognitive/context returns core_sparks, supporting_sparks, patterns, confidence, trace

tickets.title: V4 T14: context depth modes cold start and trace
tickets.description: ?depth=light|medium|deep with limits (core≤12, supporting≤20, patterns≤5). No overfill — return fewer if insufficient. Cold-start memory_items fallback when active sparks < 10. Required trace: lanes_used, selection_reason, score_basis, lineage, fallback_used. ?debug=1 score breakdown. Depends on T13.
acceptance: Underfill returns short list not padded noise

tickets.title: V4 T15: spark confidence decay and re-evaluation
tickets.description: spark_lifecycle.py: time_decay_factor = 0.5 ** (days_since_last_access/30); live_confidence = max(MIN_CONFIDENCE, base_confidence * decay). Pattern participation +0.05 capped at base_confidence. Depends on T8.
acceptance: Access updates last_accessed_at and slows decay

tickets.title: V4 T16: lifecycle transitions and maintenance
tickets.description: No hard DELETE — stale/rejected only. Only code changes trust_state/confidence. POST /api/cognitive/maintenance dry_run default. POST /api/cognitive/sparks manual seeding. Depends on T15.
acceptance: Stale + low confidence transitions to rejected

tickets.title: V4 T17: portable writeback bridge
tickets.description: ingest_terminal_writeback() dual-writes validated sparks to sparks table. Map worth_reason from why_keep when absent. Map sensitivity portable values. Legacy endpoints unchanged. Depends on T1, T6.
acceptance: Portable writeback creates sparks row and memory_item receipt

tickets.title: V4 T18: sensitivity classification and retrieval filtering
tickets.description: spark_security.py: exposure gates per sensitivity + lane. high/sensitive excluded unless lane matches; high also requires score > 0.7; high never in light depth. Depends on T3, T8.
acceptance: Sensitive spark hidden from wrong-lane query
Visible when lane matches and threshold met

tickets.title: V4 T19: prompt injection sanitization
tickets.description: spark_sanitize.py: instruction pattern detection, MEMORY_DATA delimiter wrapping, output redaction (sk-, Bearer). Apply before LLM injection and on context output. Depends on T3.
acceptance: API key patterns redacted in output

tickets.title: V4 T20: spark content security validation
tickets.description: Extend validate_spark(): reject embedded instructions ('ignore previous'), unsafe patterns, hallucinated structure. Depends on T3, T4.

tickets.title: V4 T21: cognitive API input validation and rate limits
tickets.description: Pydantic models: max 32KB ingest, 300 char spark content. Extend check_automation_guardrails(): cognitive ingest 10/min. Depends on T5.

tickets.title: V4 T22: cognitive observability and integrity chain
tickets.description: Log cognitive.ingest, cognitive.context, cognitive.maintenance to observability_store hash chain. Register dispatch invariants. Depends on T5, T13, T16.

tickets.title: V4 T23: audit trail and lineage
tickets.description: Populate lineage_json on spark create (memory_item_id, extraction_id, dedup_action). Context trace.lineage shows full chain per spark. Depends on T5, T11, T14.

tickets.title: V4 T24: V4 docs and release lock
tickets.description: Update MEMORY_HIERARCHY.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, ROADMAP.md, WHERE_WE_ARE.md. Document raw→sparks→patterns→canon, /api/cognitive/* API, safeguards, security, sensitivity mapping, no-delete policy. Bump version. Depends on all prior tickets.
acceptance: Docs define V4 cognitive memory architecture
